subject: Zora's River
text: The entrance to Zora's River is a small passage located at the 2:00 position in Hyrule Field, upstream from Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote: We're now headed for Zora's River. It's a small passage at the 2:00 position in Hyrule Field, a short ways upstream from Kakariko Village.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Rolling into the tree near the entrance of Zora's River makes a Gold Skulltula appear, which drops a token when killed.

evidence.quote: After he's gone, roll into the tree to make a Gold Skulltula appear. Kill it and take it's Token, then bomb the stones blocking the path.

subject: Stones
text: Bombs are required to clear the stones blocking the path upstream in Zora's River.

evidence.quote: Kill it and take it's Token, then bomb the stones blocking the path.

subject: Bean Man
text: The Bean Man near the iron gate in Zora's River sells Magic Beans that become progressively more expensive.

evidence.quote: Speak to the fat slob-like guy, and buy as many Magic Beans from him as you can. They become progressively more expensive as you buy more; just keep buying them until you go broke.

subject: Magic Beans
text: A Magic Bean can be planted in the patch of soft earth next to the Bean Man in Zora's River.

evidence.quote: Plant one of the Magic Beans in the patch of soft earth next to the Bean Man.

subject: Musical Frogs
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, The Sun's Song, or Saria's Song while standing on the white circle of the log awards fifty rupees per song from the frogs.

evidence.quote: Play the Frogs each of the four songs that you have learned so far (Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, The Sun's Song and Saria's Song). The frogs will award you with fifty rupees for each song.

subject: Tall Pillar
text: A Piece of Heart rests on a tall pillar in Zora's River, reached by gliding with a Cucco from the cliff with the Gossip Stone.

evidence.quote: Jump over to the cliff with the Gossip Stone on it, then turn to the west to see the tall pillar with the Piece of Heart on it. You'll have to jump out with the Cucco, and land on the pillar to get the Piece of Heart.

subject: Waterfall Path
text: A Piece of Heart is reached near the large waterfall in Zora's River by gliding out with a Cucco.

evidence.quote: Look to the left, and you will see another Piece of Heart. Leap off with the Cucco over your head, and you will glide out to the Piece of Heart (which should complete your eighth Heart Container).

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, a Gold Skulltula climbs on a ladder rising from the river bed to the zigzagging path in Zora's River and can be killed with the Slingshot for a token.

evidence.quote: If it's daytime, play the Sun's Song to make it night (time passes normally in this zone, so you won't warp back to the entrance). From the platform that you picked the Piece of Heart from, drop straight down, where you will see a ladder rising from the river bed to the zigzagging path. A Gold Skulltula climbs on it. Kill the Skulltula with the Slingshot, and climb up the ladder to take it's Token.

subject: Waterfall
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the plaque before the waterfall retracts the water and opens the entrance to Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote: From the top of the ladder, go around the zigzagging path, and stand on the plaque before the waterfall. Play Zelda's Lullaby, and the waterfall will retract, letting you access the doorway behind it. Jump over to the doorway and go through to enter Zora's Domain.

subject: Waterfall Alcove
text: Lighting all the torches and braziers in Zora's Domain before any burn out reveals a chest behind the waterfall containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: Put away your Deku Stick, and run to the left to a small alcove behind the waterfall, where there are two more braziers. Use Din's Fire to light them both. If you did it fast enough so that you lit all the braziers without any of them burning out, then a chest will appear behind the Waterfall which contains a Piece of Heart.

subject: Diving Minigame
text: Completing the Diving Minigame for 20 rupees by collecting all the rupees thrown off the waterfall rewards the Silver Scale, doubling Link's dive depth.

evidence.quote: Play the Diving Minigame with him for 20 rupees (you need it's reward, the Silver Scale, to progress)... Once you have grabbed all of the rupees from around the waterfall, the Zora will call down for you to return to him and he'll give you a reward. He'll give you the Silver Scale, which doubles how deep you can go in a single dive.

subject: Underwater Tunnel
text: Diving into the underwater tunnel south of the waterfall in Zora's Domain warps Link to Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: There is a tunnel under the water here. Dive down and enter this tunnel to warp to Lake Hylia.

subject: Lake Floor
text: A Bottle containing Princess Ruto's Letter rests on the floor of Lake Hylia near a ruined pillar south of the tunnel exit.

evidence.quote: On the floor of the lake, near a ruined pillar, there is a Bottle. Dive down and grab it. You'll find that the Bottle already contains a Letter! This is actually the SOS sent by the Princess Ruto, who is trapped inside Lord Jabu Jabu, the Zora demigod.

subject: Scarecrow
text: Playing an eight-note song with at least two different notes on the Ocarina for the Scarecrow in the lower garden teaches it a custom tune.

evidence.quote: Show the Scarecrow in the lower garden your Ocarina, and he'll ask you to play a song for him. Play the easiest eight-note song you can come up with, and don't play any of the songs you have learned or will learn later. Make sure the song has at least two different notes. Write this song down somewhere; you're going to need it later.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Releasing a Bug onto the patch of soft earth near the tall building in Lake Hylia reveals a Gold Skulltula that drops a token.

evidence.quote: Head west to the tall building, and look for a patch of soft earth near it. Release a Bug from your Bottle near the patch of earth (remember to recapture one), and kill the Gold Skulltula that appears. Take it's token, then plant one of your Magic Beans.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula appears at night on the small island with two pillars east of the dead tree in Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: Look east from the tree, and you'll see a small island with two pillars on it. Swim out to this island, and change the time to nighttime. A Gold Skulltulla will appear. Kill it and take it's Token.

subject: Island Door
text: A door built into the wall on the small island to the north in Lake Hylia leads to the Fishing Pond.

evidence.quote: Look to the north, where you will see a small island. Swim to the island, and enter the door built into the wall.

subject: Fishing Minigame
text: Catching a fish of at least nine pounds in the Fishing Pond and showing it to the Clerk awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote: In order to win the Piece of Heart, you have to capture a record breaking fish: nine pounds... Once you have captured a nine-pound fish (minimum), return to the Clerk and show him your fish. He'll give you a Piece of Heart.

subject: Fenced-in Corral
text: Dropping a bomb in the center of the fenced-in corral near Lake Hylia in Hyrule Field reveals a hidden pit.

evidence.quote: After Kaepora Gaebora is done telling you what a Lake is, move to the exact center of the corral and drop a bomb to reveal a pit.

subject: Business Scrub
text: A defeated Business Scrub inside the secret pit in the Hyrule Field corral sells a Piece of Heart for ten rupees.

evidence.quote: Drop down into the pit that appears, and defeat the Business Scrub inside. The Scrub will offer to sell you a Piece of Heart for ten rupees. That's not a typo. Ten rupees. Buy the Heart Piece, then return to Hyrule Field.

subject: Rocky Canyon
text: Heading west through the canyon road from Hyrule Field leads to Gerudo Valley.

evidence.quote: After another meeting with Kaepora Gaebora, go west into a rocky, canyon-like area. Keep going west through the canyon until you reach the zone break to Gerudo Valley.

subject: Wooden Crate
text: A Piece of Heart is hidden inside a wooden crate on a platform across the canyon in Gerudo Valley, reached by gliding across with a Cucco.

evidence.quote: Look to the opposite side of the canyon, and try to spot a small platform with a wooden crate on it. Once you have found it, jump out to it with the Cucco... Grab the Piece of Heart that was in the crate, which will cause you to drop the Cucco again.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Releasing bugs near the patch of soft earth by the Cow at the bottom of the canyon in Gerudo Valley spawns a Gold Skulltula that yields a token.

evidence.quote: Head for the southern edge of this strip of land, look for the patch of soft earth near the Cow. Release some Bugs near the patch of soft earth. Remember to recapture one of the three bugs that comes out. Kill the Gold Skulltula that appears, and take it's Token.

subject: Waterfall Ladder
text: A Piece of Heart sits at the top of a ladder behind the waterfall at the bottom of Gerudo Valley, accessed using a Cucco.

evidence.quote: Look behind the waterfall, and you will see a ladder. Jump out to the ladder, and don't drop the Cucco until you're pressing your face right up next to it... Climb to the top of the ladder, where you will find another Piece of Heart.

subject: Submerged Ruins
text: An underwater tunnel located in the submerged ruins in Lake Hylia leads back to Zora's Domain.

evidence.quote: Swim to the submerged ruins near the shore, to the east of the Observatory and the west of the Scarecrows. Dive into the water and swim into the tunnel to return to Zora's Domain.

subject: King Zora
text: Presenting the Bottled Letter to King Zora causes him to move aside, revealing the passage to Zora's Fountain.

evidence.quote: Return to King Zora's Throne Room, and show him the Bottled Letter. He'll then, uh... "move" aside, and beg Link to save his daughter from Jabu Jabu's Belly.

subject: Shallow Water
text: Fish swimming in the shallow water near the waterfall in Zora's Domain can be caught in an empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: For now, return to the bottom level of Zora's Domain, and go to the area of shallow water near the waterfall. Catch one of the fish who swim around here in an empty Bottle.

subject: Throne Room Tunnel
text: The tunnel behind King Zora's throne leads directly to Zora's Fountain.

evidence.quote: Go through the tunnel behind his throne to reach Zora's Fountain.
